‍Which is why you have to have the best equipment, tools, and pieces of furniture for your station.

And of course, the main and one of the most important products is the desk.

This article will share the list of our favorite graphic design desks, which we identified by category.

Also explained why it’s our top choice, plus a guide that will help you create your criteria for the perfect desk.

How to choose the best desks for graphic designers

As we said, graphic design desks may be different depending on the preference of the designer.

However, there are still important factors that should be considered when choosing one:

  1. Budget
  2. Size
  3. Quality and Stability
  4. Ergonomics
  5. Storage Space

These are just practical ideas that you should be remembering even before you start shopping for a desk, and here’s why:

Budget

When shopping, the amount of money you’re willing to spend on a desk is a significant deciding factor.

‍The reality is if you want to guarantee a great quality piece, you may need to add to your budget.

However, keep in mind that you don’t have to overspend since there are still several office desks out there that offer great value with a less hefty price tag.

It’s best if you set a budget beforehand so you avoid splurging more than what you can afford; plus, having a price range will help you narrow down your options.

Size

Work desks nowadays come in different sizes, suitable to different preferences.

When choosing the most appropriate size for your graphic design desk will hugely rely on two factors: your office space and preferred set-up.

Envision the type of set-up for your station, whether you want a more simple one or maybe an all-in-one space where you have everything you need in one area.

You should also measure the space you want to allocate for the desk.

Remember that a large desk overcrowding a room is not a good call.

For better productivity, you need an uncluttered office space with sufficient room for you to move around comfortably.

Quality and Stability

Consider a graphic design desk as a large piece of investment that will help you do better at work.

So you need one that offers great quality and can be guaranteed to last for a long time.

It also needs to have sturdy frames, so the whole desk remains stable the entire time you’re working.

Ergonomics

Graphic designers, especially those who work from home, are likely to be working more than eight hours per day.

Because of this, they spend the majority of the day hunched in front of a computer, which is obviously bad for your health.

With ergonomic office furniture like a desk can be a solution.

An ergonomic desk helps your posture and spine and boosts the overall efficiency of a creative, and it also promotes healthy well-being.

Storage space

Having shelves and drawers may not be important to everyone when choosing desks.

However, an ample storage space, especially one that doesn’t bulk up the desk design, is always great, especially for those who with limited room.

Now, without further ado, here are my top 10 graphic design desks.

One of the standout features of the E7 is its stability, because even when I top my stuff unevenly on the desk, it remains stable and does not wobble or shake.

This is a huge plus for me because as a graphic designer I often have a lot of items on my desk and need a stable surface to work on.
